The '''Mystic Rug''' is a piece of [[furniture]] available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

One Mystic Rug is obtained when the [[Farmhouse|Bedroom]] is redecorated by [[Penny]] in her [[Penny#Fourteen Hearts|14-Heart]] event, choosing Forest and Moon: Peaceful Blue.
